issues.message: The match_position_cut is not supportable because beat 15 has no inspectable pixels, so positional correspondence into the centered passenger rows cannot be verified; it also conflicts with beat 15's declared plain cut transition_out. Use a standard continuity cut and retain the wide hold.

attention_story: Keep the cabin broad and center-weighted so the distant rear opening, seated rows, and calm foreground remain readable together.
Use stillness through the final contrast word so the reduced airflow idea lands without adding unnecessary motion.

motion.reason: The narration resolves on the contrast word 'less,' and the wide static composition best communicates weaker movement farther from the opening while preserving the scholar, passengers, aisle, and distant opening.

transition_out.reason: The following beat continues the same explanatory cabin idea, so a clean cut preserves continuity without spending a decorative transition.
